title: Preallocate SUBQUERY schema keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when subquery local-scope paths build schema:<table> lookup keys from known table-name length.
implementation: Added subquery_schema_key_for_table() with explicit capacity for schema:<table>.
Replaced table_factor_schema_if_simple_table() schema lookup key construction.
Replaced append_local_scope_for_factor() schema lookup key construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: SUBQUERY schema-key construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving subquery materialization, correlated EXISTS membership, CTE behavior, recursive query behavior, and join-side query behavior.
